rationale: The held ProQuest text identifies EO 2489 (Wilson, 21 November 1916). Its single clause reserves the NE1/4 sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., N.M.P.M., for military purposes. EO 8376 (5 FR 1077 and the APP mirror; both basis spans and all hashes match the held bytes) lists that tract and in paragraph 2 revokes EO 2489 by number, signed 13 March 1940, with no savings clause and no stated effective date. The interval 1916-11-21 to 1940-03-13 matches the sources and the rationale. The number search finds EO 2489 cited only in the two EO 8376 copies, so there is no earlier ending, and NO rests on primary text rather than an editorial snapshot. Both texts are transcription or OCR grade, not originals, so the standing transcription note applies.
